## Implementation Checklist

### Development
- [ ] Define TypeScript interfaces/types
- [ ] Implement core logic
- [ ] Add input validation
- [ ] Implement error handling
- [ ] Add logging (ensure no PHI)
- [ ] Write JSDoc documentation

### Testing
- [ ] Write unit tests (minimum 5)
- [ ] Write integration test
- [ ] Test error scenarios
- [ ] Verify performance (<3s response time)
- [ ] Test with SHARP context
- [ ] Test without SHARP context

### Safety & Compliance
- [ ] HIPAA compliance review
- [ ] No PHI in logs verified
- [ ] Input sanitization complete
- [ ] API key security verified
- [ ] Safety validation tests pass

### Documentation
- [ ] Update API.md
- [ ] Add usage examples
- [ ] Update README if needed
- [ ] Add integration guide
